stage: TRACE-ARACNe T1 (links L1-L4, frozen prediction, 2 real + 5 negative controls)
weighting: unweighted (P7, w=1); likelihood carried not used

fulvestrant_ESR1_BRCA_LumA.label: TF-anchored
fulvestrant_ESR1_BRCA_LumA.control: not a control: the TF-anchored trace, re-run on ARACNe

vemurafenib_BRAF_TCGA_SKCM.label: Kinase
vemurafenib_BRAF_TCGA_SKCM.control: not a control: the kinase trace, re-run on ARACNe

NC1_target_not_expressed.label: NC1_target_not_expressed
NC1_target_not_expressed.control: target not expressed in the source line; L5 must break
NC1_target_not_expressed.why: RET log2(TPM+1) = 0.029 in HCC515 (DepMap 24Q4), i.e. not expressed, while the target still reaches 85 ARACNe regulators in LUAD so L1-L4 can run. Chosen as the candidate with the most reachable regulators among 552 rows with TPM<0.25 and >=3 regulators -- deliberately the HARDEST such case for the procedure.

NC2_raf_paradox.label: NC2_raf_paradox
NC2_raf_paradox.control: RAF inhibitor in BRAF-wild-type, RAS-active context; the chain must not close
NC2_raf_paradox.why: MDA-MB-231 carries no BRAF V600 mutation and a hotspot KRAS p.G13D (DepMap 24Q4 somatic calls), the paradoxical-activation context in which a RAF inhibitor activates rather than inhibits ERK signalling. The predicted footprint sign is therefore expected to be WRONG, not merely weak. 27 candidate rows; most reachable regulators chosen.

NC3_random_pairing.label: NC3_random_pairing
NC3_random_pairing.control: drug paired with a cohort it was not matched to; L2 or L7 must break
NC3_random_pairing.why: seed 20261117, first draw satisfying: cohort != the drug's own matched cohort (TCGA-SKCM), the drug has a profile in a celligner line of the drawn cohort, and the target reaches >=1 ARACNe regulator there. No property of TCGA-READ was used to pick it.

NC4_cytotoxic.label: NC4_cytotoxic
NC4_cytotoxic.control: cytotoxic drug with a routable targeted annotation; L6 and the cytotoxicity alternative must fire rather than the chain closing on the annotation
NC4_cytotoxic.why: STRUCTURAL FINDING FIRST: TOP1, TOP2A, TYMS, DHFR, GART, RRM1, TUBB have zero OmniPath route rows, so a classical chemotherapeutic acting through its own effector cannot be traced at all - it would be 'not evaluable' at L3, which is NC5's test, not a cytotoxicity test. The cytotoxicity control therefore uses a drug whose MOA is purely cytotoxic ('DNA alkylating agent') but whose annotated unit (ESR2) does route to 4 ARACNe regulators in BRCA_LUMB: estramustine in MCF7. The chain is able to close here, and if it does, the procedure cannot tell a targeted mechanism from cell death. 12 such rows in the pool; most reachable regulators chosen.

NC5_no_anchored_tf.label: NC5_no_anchored_tf
NC5_no_anchored_tf.control: target reaches no regulator; L3 must return 'not evaluable' rather than a path
NC5_no_anchored_tf.why: KDR HAS 121 OmniPath route rows, but none resolves to a regulator with an ARACNe regulon in LIHC within the frozen hop cap. 347 such rows in the pool; the highest-celligner-weight line chosen. The correct behaviour is an empty footprint and a 'not evaluable' L3, NOT a footprint assembled from ambiguous routes.
